- Security/privacy/NFR impact:
- Waiver or release decision:

## Checks

- [ ] `make traceability` passes.
- [ ] Generated traceability diff was reviewed.
- [ ] Behavior changes update the normative source and criteria.
- [ ] UI hiding is backed by server authorization where applicable.
- [ ] Evidence contains no secret, terminal bytes, file content, or private absolute path.

If this change has no requirement impact, explain why and request review from the affected
component owner. Changes to authentication, WebSockets, runtime launching, workspace/files,
credentials, audit, update, or deployment may not use an author-only no-impact assertion.
